scope: Bounded independent automated development/publication audit of tracked local changes relative to local origin/main, selected failure controls, source claims, sizes, and credential patterns. No external clinical certification, comprehensive security/privacy assurance, provider inference, network fetch, remote write, or original-results rewrite.
release_authorization: User authorized repository and whitepaper publication by the single physician-engineer author; independent human review is future research, not a release prerequisite.
outcome: Bounded regression checks pass and the CI/source-path/claim findings were repaired by their owners. Pre-existing semantic rubric, schema, and wall-clock seeding limitations remain; the release must disclose them rather than assert full validity or byte-identical worlds. Final full-suite, PDF/archive builds, and remote publication are parent-owned.

limitations: Only tracked files and newly reachable local history were screened; unrelated untracked directories and .env were not inspected or included.

Pattern screening does not prove absence of all secrets or PHI. No specific real-patient data was identified; inspected scenario provenance and integration documentation describe authored synthetic data and exclusion of MIMIC/STARR data.
No model weights, database files, private-key files or .env files were tracked; .env.example is tracked.

findings.description: Figure generation imported healthcraft while whitepaper CI installed only matplotlib, causing ModuleNotFoundError in an isolated source-layout import. Root added constrained editable project installation; final workflow build is root-owned.

Missing artifacts/ source paths were ignored. Added the root to existing structural source checks; absent literal/pointer/glob sources fail; existing and explicitly deferred paths retain their documented behavior.

Removed unsupported inference determinism from aggregation, aggregate judge-error direction, generational claims from incomparable runs, and attribution of observed variation specifically to sampling rather than provider variability. Named existing semantic counterexamples now appear in README and manuscript.

81 validation errors across64 historical tasks:54 time-pressure enum,18 cognitive-load enum,7 literal clinical-field shapes,2 openem-condition shapes. General loader/CLI/preflight do not enforce full task-schema conformance. No protectedtask rewrite or clinical coercion.

Identical seed/config does not yield byte-identical full worlds: created_at/updated_at vary across12collections and clinical_task.due_time also varies. Same IDs/counts/world clock in the installed optional-OpenEM runtime. README/paper must qualify environmental determinism; root notified.
